(2) The camera pans right to reveal more kitchen organization items, including a wooden spice rack with glass jars, a paper towel dispenser, and silicone cooking utensils such as spatulas and ladles neatly arranged. (3) A hand with light nail polish enters the frame to demonstrate a beige apron and a matching cutting board with a silver knife placed on top. (4) The hand picks up and displays a clear plastic airtight storage container with a beige lid, showcasing its mechanism. (5) A flat-lay arrangement follows, showing grey utensils and a grey cutting board on the white surface. (6) A smartphone is held up to the camera, displaying the 'kakai.tw' website with promotional banners and pricing. (7) The final phase shows a wide view of the organized kitchen counter before transitioning to a close-up of a hand holding a red envelope decorated with gold patterns.
